overview_description.description: Arabian Calibration Company is a company that offers both fixed and mobile calibration services for impartial liquid and flow meters. Clients have access to a self-governing calibration facility that complies with operational requirements through the company's services, which concentrate on the delivery of flow measurement, verification, and calibration services. This enables clients to get concise engineering for their meter calibrations.

about_short_description.short_description: Arabian Calibration is a liquid and flow meter calibration company that offers mobile calibration services.

product.name: Flow Meter Calibration Services
product.description: Calibration of liquid flow meters to ensure accurate measurement performance, conducted at a fixed facility or on-site using mobile rigs.

product.name: Flow Meter Verification Services
product.description: On-site verification of flow meters using clamp-on ultrasonic technology to assess meter performance without removal from service.

product.name: Flow Measurement Consultancy Services
product.description: Consultancy services including meter selection studies, measurement audits, and Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) analysis to optimize flow measurement systems.

product.name: Measurement Skid Design and Fabrication
product.description: Design and fabrication of customized metering and water-in-oil monitoring skids, including installation and ongoing support.

product.name: Fixed Test Bench Products
product.description: Fixed gravimetric and piston prover test benches for calibrating flow meters of various sizes and flow rates at a stationary facility.

product.name: Mobile Test Bench Products
product.description: Mobile, compact test benches for on-site calibration of flow meters, supporting various meter sizes and flow rates with automated control.
